name: Azerbaijan
shortSummary: India-Azerbaijan relations are relatively distant, shaped by Azerbaijan's close alignment with Pakistan and Türkiye in a trilateral "brotherhood" framework that has drawn Indian wariness.

majorChallenges.title: Alignment with Pakistan and Türkiye
majorChallenges.description: Azerbaijan's close ties with Pakistan and Türkiye have limited the warmth of its relationship with India.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
